points.description: Identifies the SVM as a linear classification machine (classifier) that uses a decision boundary/hyperplane with maximum margin (large margin) to separate the data into different classes. Equivalent wording accepted (e.g. 'maximum-margin hyperplane separating classes').
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of 'linear classifier' or 'maximum margin decision boundary separating classes' is given.

points.description: States that support vectors are the data points closest to the decision boundary (on the margin), that the margin is determined only by these points, and mentions either that slack variables/soft margin handle non-linearly separable data or that the problem is solved by Quadratic Programming. Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if only support vectors/margin determined by them is given without slack variables or quadratic programming.
